title: Eros alerts option label typo wrong
symptom: The configuration page for Eros alerts shows a label saying '72 Hours' but it should say '80h' because the alert is relative to 80 hours before expiry.
cause: The label text is a typo; it incorrectly states 72 hours instead of 80 hours for Eros alert configuration.
fix: The label was corrected via a commit (2c992dfd6824d52a3554df5794cccc7b70c4a037) to say 80 hours instead of 72.
evidence_quote: "Reminder at hours before expiry (72 Hours)" this should be 80?
